run_uncompress_s2ef_datasets: run the uncompress script to decompress S2EF dataset files from a compressed directory
run_read_lzma_single_file: run read_lzma to decompress a single lzma compressed file to an output path
run_decompress_list_of_files: run decompress_list_of_files to decompress a pair of input and output file paths
run_main_with_args: run main with argparse args specifying input directory, output directory, and number of workers
run_get_parser: run get_parser to create an argparse parser with ipdir, opdir, and num-workers arguments
